evals.prompt: Show me how to set up the Directus SDK with TypeScript types and do basic CRUD
expectations: Uses createDirectus with composable pattern (rest, staticToken)
Shows readItems with fields and filter

evals.prompt: How do I subscribe to real-time changes on a collection with the Directus SDK?
evals.expected_output: realtime() composable, connect(), subscribe(), for-await loop
expectations: Uses realtime() composable in client setup
Uses client.subscribe() with collection name and event type
Shows for-await-of loop for consuming events

evals.prompt: How do I log in with email and password using the Directus SDK in a Node.js script?
evals.expected_output: authentication('json') client, login with a payload object, stopRefreshing for one-shot scripts
expectations: Calls client.login with a single payload object { email, password }, not two positional arguments
Uses authentication('json') for Node.js because the default cookie mode needs a cookie jar
Mentions optional login options (otp, mode, provider) and the LDAP identifier payload
Mentions Node 22 or later for SDK 26 and stopRefreshing for one-shot scripts
